arguments.content:
While I can’t advise on strawberries or anything involving bees, you can boost indoor growth by keeping your *basil* in a clean hydro setup with steady nutrients, strong light, warm temperatures, and periodic pruning to encourage bushy new leaves. Make sure your *basil* roots get plenty of oxygen, avoid letting nutrient strength swing too much between water changes, and remove any yellowing leaves so the plant focuses on healthy growth. What kind of light schedule and nutrient strength are you currently using for your *basil*?
